# Is There a Burn Ban?

> Look up county reports about temporary burn bans and standing restrictions. Each publisher has its own schedule and coverage. Confirm which area and activity the issuing order covers before you burn.

## Read API

The JSON API needs no key. Use the result's `scope`, `scopeNote`, `orders`, check time and publisher when quoting a report. A failed check may leave an earlier report visible through its freshness or validity window.

- [Status by ZIP](https://site.example/api/v1/status?zip=74103) uses Census 2020 ZIP areas and orders counties by land overlap. If the ZIP is absent, `approximate`, `matchedZip` and `approximationReason` identify a numeric substitute with the same prefix. Confirm a county, then look it up by FIPS.
- [Status by coordinates](https://site.example/api/v1/status?lat=36.154&lon=-95.993) uses rounded coordinates and the 2020 Census county boundaries. The opt-in `here=1` IP estimate returns candidates for confirmation.
- [Status by county FIPS](https://site.example/api/v1/status?fips=48453)
- [Status by city](https://site.example/api/v1/status?city=Tulsa&state=OK) uses mapped Census incorporated places. Results include a `place` object. When counties disagree, the place answer is `depends`. City fire rules may apply separately.
- [Plain-text answer](https://site.example/api/v1/status?zip=74103&format=text)
- [One county](https://site.example/api/v1/counties/40143)
- [Published active reports](https://site.example/api/v1/bans) and [by state](https://site.example/api/v1/bans?state=TX) include scoped restrictions. Continue the national list using `nextCursor` as `cursor`, including after empty pages. State-filtered lists are returned in full.
- [Coverage and source health](https://site.example/api/v1/coverage) distinguishes full, positive-only and manual sources.
- [Map statuses](https://site.example/api/v1/map-status) return a publication revision, expiry and known statuses keyed by FIPS. Missing counties are unknown.
- [Published NWS fire-weather signals](https://site.example/api/v1/fire-weather), optionally [filtered by state](https://site.example/api/v1/fire-weather?state=OK). Check the alert's area, onset and source health. Some local rules apply during a Red Flag Warning.
- [OpenAPI description for the read API](https://site.example/openapi.json)

`ban` is a reported ban. `restricted` covers targeted rules such as activity limits, local orders and permit requirements. `none` means the applicable feed reported no temporary county ban within its coverage. `unknown` means the status is unconfirmed. In positive-only feeds, omissions stay unknown.

`checked` is the last successful source check, or null if unavailable. `generated` is the publication time. `since` is the publisher's effective date when known. `sourceUpdated` is the publisher's report time. `firstSeenAt` and `statusChangedAt` are observations by this service.

## MCP

- Streamable HTTP endpoint is https://site.example/mcp (stateless, no authentication).
- `check_burn_ban` accepts ZIP, coordinates, county FIPS or city and state. Present location uncertainty and scope before giving an answer. Cite the issuing order when available.
- `list_active_bans` lists published reports. Pass a state for a full state list or use `nextCursor` to continue a national list. `coverage` reports source coverage and health.
- `subscribe_email_alerts` is the only tool that writes. Use it when someone asks for alerts and provides their email. If email delivery is enabled, a confirmation email goes out first. After confirmation we attempt alerts for eligible changes we detect.
- [Client setup and API examples](https://site.example/developers/)

## Pages and data

- County pages use https://site.example/us/{state}/{county-slug}/. [Tulsa County example](https://site.example/us/ok/tulsa-county/)
- City pages use https://site.example/us/{state}/city/{city-slug}/. [Tulsa example](https://site.example/us/ok/city/tulsa/)
- [Dataset and attribution](https://site.example/data/) explains report coverage. Cite the publisher and `officialUrl`, which may be a directory for unconfirmed counties. Verify publishers' terms before redistributing data.
- [Terms](https://site.example/terms/) and [privacy](https://site.example/privacy/) describe data reuse, lookup caching, usage counts and subscriptions.
